headline: Marcos Inspects PICC Ahead of Philippines' ASEAN Summit Hosting
seoTitle: Marcos Inspects PICC Ahead of ASEAN Summit | FMB News
seoDescription: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. inspected the PICC on September 3 to assess preparations for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.
deck: The November summit will bring regional leaders to Manila, making venue readiness, security and logistics a major government priority.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. inspected the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City on September 3 as part of preparations for the Philippines' hosting of the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.

sections.heading: What he checked
paragraphs: The President conducted a walkthrough to assess the venue's readiness following renovation and preparation work for the regional meetings.

sections.heading: Schedule
paragraphs: The main ASEAN gathering is scheduled for November 10 to 12, with related events continuing through November 15.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Hosting the summit requires coordinated diplomatic, security, transport, media and venue operations for leaders and delegations from across Southeast Asia and partner countries.
